# Triton One Documentation

Premium bare-metal Solana infrastructure: reads, streaming, history, trading APIs and validator services. Built for teams running production workloads.

## Getting started

1. Sign up at https://customers.triton.one/users/sign-up
2. Top up the $125 minimum (card, USDC, hel.io or wire)
3. Provision a Solana mainnet endpoint, copy your URL and token
4. Make your first request to `getSlot`

Full quickstart: https://docs.triton.one/solana/get-started/quickstart

## Product index

### Reading state

- **Standard RPC** — Solana JSON-RPC over HTTPS, all standard methods. https://docs.triton.one/solana/reading-state/standard-rpc
- **Steamboat** — Custom indexes built from your gRPC stream, 50x faster than `getProgramAccounts`. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/steamboat/overview
- **DAS API** — Unified read for NFTs, cNFTs, SPL, Token-2022. https://docs.triton.one/solana/digital-assets/das-api/overview
- **Account Sync** — Live account-state mirror, Geyser-fed, no polling. https://docs.triton.one/solana/reading-state/account-sync
- **ZK Compression** — Compressed accounts, Merkle indexer. https://docs.triton.one/solana/digital-assets/zk-compression/overview

### Streaming

- **Dragon's Mouth gRPC** — Sub-slot account, transaction, slot and block subscriptions. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/dragons-mouth/overview
- **Whirligig** — Drop-in replacement for native Solana WebSockets, custom `transactionSubscribe`. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/whirligig/overview
- **Fumarole** — Multi-node merge, persistent storage, resume from cursor. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/fumarole/overview
- **Hermes** — Pyth price feed API, REST plus WebSocket. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/hermes/overview
- **Pythnet** — Pyth oracle source-of-truth chain, Solana Foundation backed. https://docs.triton.one/solana/streaming/pythnet/overview

### History

- **Hydrant** — Millisecond ledger queries from genesis, ClickHouse-backed, 400+ TB. https://docs.triton.one/solana/history/hydrant/overview
- **Old Faithful** — Open archive of every block from genesis, JSON-RPC and gRPC. https://docs.triton.one/solana/history/old-faithful/overview
- **Faithful Streams** — Replay history live, same API as Dragon's Mouth. https://docs.triton.one/solana/history/faithful-streams/overview

### Sending transactions

- **Yellowstone Jet** — SWQoS TPU client, direct-to-leader transaction submission via QUIC. https://docs.triton.one/solana/sending-transactions/yellowstone-jet/overview
- **Priority Fees API** — Smart per-program fee estimation. https://docs.triton.one/solana/sending-transactions/priority-fees/overview
- **Metis** — Jupiter swap routing, 20+ DEXes scanned, optimal route. https://docs.triton.one/solana/trading-apis/metis/overview
- **Titan Prime** — Streaming swaps, DART live re-optimisation. https://docs.triton.one/solana/trading-apis/titan-prime/overview
- **Jito Bundles** — Tips-based bundle ordering, direct-to-leader. https://docs.triton.one/solana/sending-transactions/jito-bundles/overview

### Dedicated and validator services

- **Dedicated gRPC node** — Private endpoint, no shared rate limits, Yellowstone gRPC included. https://docs.triton.one/solana/reading-state/dedicated-grpc
- **White-label validator** — Branded validator on Triton infrastructure. https://docs.triton.one/solana/validators/white-label/overview
- **Private trusted validator** — Validator-as-a-service for stake delegation, no third-party operators. https://docs.triton.one/solana/validators/private-trusted/overview

## By use case

| Building... | Recommended stack |
|---|---|
| Trading or market making | Dragon's Mouth, Yellowstone Jet, Priority Fees, Fumarole |
| DEX or DeFi protocol | Dragon's Mouth, Yellowstone Jet, Hydrant, Priority Fees |
| Wallet or consumer app | Standard RPC, DAS API, Whirligig |
| NFT or compressed-asset platform | DAS API, ZK Compression, Whirligig |
| Indexer or analytics | Steamboat, Hydrant, Old Faithful, Vixen |
| Institutional or RWA | Dedicated gRPC, White-label validator, dedicated tier |
| Gaming or high-throughput consumer | Standard RPC, DAS API, Dragon's Mouth, Whirligig |
| AI agent or LLM app | MCP (coming soon), llms.txt, Standard RPC, DAS API |
